extracted.intended_audience: NIH/NIH-style grant applicants (PD/PI, senior/key personnel, grant administrators) preparing R&R Research & Related Budget, budget justification, and biosketch (e.g., K99/R00 applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for completing NIH Research & Related Budget (Sections A–K), Budget Justification, and the Biographical Sketch for senior/key personnel in an application (example: K99/R00). Includes required fields, cost categories, and supporting narrative detail required by NIH forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include NAME; eRA Commons user name; POSITION TITLE; EDUCATION/TRAINING (begin with baccalaureate, include postdoctoral training). Provide institution and location, degree, completion date, and field of study as shown in the Education/Training table. Follow the specified format exactly and keep the biosketch to five pages or fewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — required header fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizational DUNS*, Budget Type* (Project or Subaward/Consortium), Enter name of Organization, Start Date, End Date, Budget Period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the form header for each budget period. Indicate whether the submission is a Project or a Subaward/Consortium and provide organizational identifiers (DUNS), exact start/end dates and the budget period number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person budget line-item requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Senior/Key person provide Prefix, First Name, Middle, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base (calendar, academic, summer) months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report months of effort separately for calendar, academic, and summer appointments; show salary requested per person per period and associated fringe. Provide totals for all Senior/Key persons in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other personnel categories and counts
rubrics_metrics.description: List number of personnel by role (e.g., Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical) and provide calendar/academic/summer months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide headcounts for each category, months of effort, salary requested, fringe and subtotal funds requested; include a total number of other personnel and total salary/wages and fringe (A+B).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment listing threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Equipment (Section C), itemize each equipment purchase whose unit cost exceeds $5,000 and provide total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel cost categorization
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide separate entries for Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs and a Total Travel Cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break down travel by domestic vs foreign and show totals; in the Budget Justification provide intended uses (conferences, courses) and a numeric breakdown (registration, flights, hotels/meals) where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Participant/Trainee Support Costs into: Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance; Stipends; Travel; Subsistence; Other, and report Number of Participants/Trainees and Total Participant/Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each subcategory with funds requested and include the number of participants/trainees supported in the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Other Direct Costs including: 1) Materials and Supplies, 2) Publication Costs, 3) Consultant Services, 4) ADP/Computer Services, 5) Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, 6) Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, 7) Alterations and Renovations (and other listed items).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide funds requested for each listed Other Direct Cost category and a Total Other Direct Costs amount for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs reporting and calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify Indirect Cost Type (e.g., Modified Total Direct Costs), Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested for indirect costs; identify Cognizant Federal Agency and POC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the institutional or negotiated indirect cost rate to the specified base, show the dollar calculation and cite the cognizant federal agency contact. Example in text: 'Indirect costs are calculated at 8% of the Modified Total Direct Cost base rate.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Totals and cumulative budget presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Total Direct Costs (A thru F), Total Indirect Costs (H), Total Direct and Indirect Costs (I = G + H), Fee (J), and Total Costs and Fee (K). Include a cumulative budget table across budget periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize and display totals clearly for each budget period and cumulatively; include tracking number, funding opportunity number, and received date metadata as shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification narrative detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Budget Justification describing Personnel (salary justification), Travel (number of conferences, per-item breakdown), Supplies, Publication costs, and Indirect cost calculation for each phase (Mentored K99 and R00).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give specific dollar amounts and rationale (e.g., 'two years of funding for the K99 fellow with a proposed salary of $75,000 per year, based on National Institute of Aging guidelines'). For travel, give per-conference registration, flights, and hotel/meals amounts. For supplies, list anticipated uses (lab supplies, sequencing fees, high-processing computer). State publication cost estimates and note when R00 justification will be provided (upon faculty position).

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with funding mechanism phases (K99/R00) and mentor role
rubrics_metrics.description: State the requested support separately for the Mentored K99 Phase and the Independent R00 Phase and describe mentor involvement and salary request policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the K99 mentored phase specify duration, salary and that the mentor may not request salary (example: 'Dr. Andrew Dillin will serve as the mentor ... No salary is requested for the mentor'). For the R00, indicate the planned annual budget and that a specific justification will be provided upon receipt of an independent faculty position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research support / grant listing format in biosketch or CV
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing and completed research support entries with grant number, awarding agency, project title, major goals of the project, role (e.g., PI), and project dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the major goals concisely and state the role explicitly (e.g., 'Role: PI'). If relevant, include overlap statements about aims (e.g., '*The aims in this grant are unique from Ashley’s K99/R00 application and there is no overlap.') and include citations (PMID/PMCID) for referenced publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training information layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide EDUCATION/TRAINING entries beginning with baccalaureate or professional education and including postdoctoral training: list INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE, COMPLETION, FIELD OF STUDY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the table-style layout shown on the form for each training entry to ensure consistent, complete educational history in the biosketch.
